paragraph_requires: The Company computes net loss per share under the two-class method
For periods in which the Company reports net losses
includes 38.5 million shares related to the Share Consideration
the number of shares issuable to the Non-Accelerated Sellers was finalized and determined to be 10.5 million shares
(in millions, except share and per share amounts)
decisions.reader_note: For Compass in 2023–2025, the two-class method gives the same loss per share for Class A, B and C common stock because their economic rights are substantially identical apart from voting rights. Potential dilution is excluded in loss periods. The 2025 denominator already includes the filing’s 38.5 million merger-consideration shares from the January 13 acquisition date, including 10.1 million minimum issuable shares; the January 2026 finalization to 10.5 million is not substituted into the selected 2025 figures. Full scale-zero shares remain under the share/per-share exception to the millions heading.

paragraph_requires: We compute net loss per share using the two-class method
adjusted for RSAs for which the risk of forfeiture has not yet lapsed
For the periods presented, our potentially dilutive shares relating to stock options, RSUs, RSAs, and the Convertible Notes were not included
decisions.reader_note: For Snap in 2023–2025, the statement reports combined weighted-average shares for Class A, B and C, with class-specific loss-per-share accounting under the two-class method. Basic shares are adjusted for restricted stock awards whose forfeiture risk has not lapsed. Potential shares from options, RSUs, RSAs and convertible notes are excluded as anti-dilutive in these loss periods. The filing uses the if-converted method for potential dilution from its convertible notes. Scale-three share counts and scale-zero EPS remain unchanged under the statement’s thousands heading.
